name: Waldfeucht (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of red, white and red in the proportions 1:4:1, charged towards the hoist with the municipal arms of Waldfeucht (a red lion on white above a black figure on yellow).
history: The official blazon of the arms is given in the deed of the Regierungspräsident Köln of 14 March 1977; the flag is red, white and red striped 1:4:1 with the shield shifted towards the staff, the banner with the shield above the centre.
